steps.title: Configure Application Metadata and Package Configuration
steps.description: Ensure accurate app meta specification and package identifier structure for Al Faris Kirana.

steps.title: Define Brand Palette, Color Tokens, and Material Styles
steps.description: Configure emerald jewel brand colors, background neutrals, metric container strokes, and button styling in colors.xml, styles.xml, and strings.xml.

steps.title: Create Dynamic Surface Backgrounds, Header Badges, and Custom Buttons
steps.description: Design gradient header shapes, white elevated cards, input field selectors, pill status indicators, and custom button drawables.

steps.title: Enhance Data Models for Customers and Ledger Transactions
steps.description: Define updated Customer and UdhaarTransaction objects supporting Total Udhaar, Total Jama, Pending Balance, and Customer Advance.

steps.title: Upgrade Database Architecture for Udhaar and Jama Ledger Accounting
steps.description: Implement robust SQLite transaction logic in DatabaseHelper to isolate Credit (Udhaar) and Payment (Jama) records and compute strict non-negative pending balances.

steps.title: Construct Udhaar Entry and Payment Repayment Dialog Interfaces
steps.description: Create clean modal dialog XML layouts for recording new credit transactions and customer payment deposits with method selection.

steps.title: Upgrade Customer Directory View and Search Filtering System
steps.description: Modify CustomerListActivity and item_customer.xml to display Total Udhaar, Total Jama, and Pending Udhaar metrics with live search capability.

steps.title: Build Customer Summary Dashboard with Three Independent Totals
steps.description: Engineer CustomerDetailActivity showcasing Total Udhaar, Total Jama, and Pending Udhaar summary cards along with separate Udhaar and Jama tabs.

steps.title: Update Main Store POS Dashboard with Store Metrics
steps.description: Refactor MainActivity and activity_main.xml to reflect live aggregate metrics for Total Pending Udhaar, Total Jama Received, and Store Sales.

steps.title: Building Al Faris Kirana
steps.description: Compile layout resources, validate database calculations, link activity navigation routes, and build the updated APK package.
